release_read.basis: Q3 revenue $269.9m in line with ~$268m consensus and non-GAAP EPS $0.17 beats ($0.13 Benzinga snippet, $0.08 Nasdaq), but the Q4 revenue guide $385-420m (mid $402.5m) sits below a ~$427m street number (snippet_only) and the release cites US capacity delays from power; washed-out positioning (-55% in 20d, ~15% short) cushions it against an 18% straddle.

release.released_at_note: release dated 2026-11-05 after the close; exact minute not verified
release.headline: Applied Optoelectronics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

key_line.detail: Q4 revenue $385-420m (mid $402.5m, +49% q/q) vs Benzinga Q4 consensus ~$427.3m (snippet_only): about 6% light at the midpoint; Q4 non-GAAP EPS $0.48-0.63 vs ~$0.55 consensus, in line; GM guide 29.5-31%. Release notes US capacity expansion delayed by power access.

guidance.detail: Q4 revenue guide midpoint below street (snippet_only consensus); EPS guide in line. Labelled 'lowered' relative to street, not relative to a prior company guide.

call.detail: Call held last night; content not reviewed in the time available. After-hours traded down to -7.6% before the pre-market reversed.

public_reaction.summary: No time to search analyst actions or retail tone before the 09:24 compile.

tape_read.note: After-hours last -7.6%, pre-market reversed to +4.2% on the robust reference (48.85; last 49.32, +5.2%; range 45.99-50.49), 289 prints, 30 in the last 30m, live to 09:19, not stale. QQQ +1.7% supplies part of it. Against a frozen read of -3% the pre-market holds about 7 points more than the release supports: a short-covering bounce in a washed-out, 15%-short name.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a mild long on washed-out positioning and peer beats; the print beat on EPS but the Q4 guide is below street. The bounce is the positioning half of the thesis, not the release.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market that is still near its upper half, so the open should hold most of the +4%; a gap that already reversed from -7.6% after hours on a soft guide, in a sector that has been selling beats, is more likely to give part back in the first half hour.

recommendation.reason: De positie staat voorbeurs zo'n 4% in de plus, maar de cijfers zelf rechtvaardigen dat niet: de omzetprognose voor Q4 ligt onder wat analisten verwachtten. De stijging lijkt vooral het dekken van shortposities en een sterke Nasdaq; verkoop op de opening, zoals de standaardregel voor amc ook doet.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 doorstijgt boven 50,49 met veel transacties, of er komen koersdoelverhogingen van analisten binnen, dan is vasthouden tot 10:00 te overwegen.
